about: What every folder in the repo is, one line each (restructure J6.1). node tools/handbook.mjs map joins it with docs/handbook/deploy-map.json (who uploads it, where) and the files themselves (how many, which languages) into docs/handbook/generated/map.md; node tools/handbook.mjs check refuses a folder that isn't here.

The repo's root: the build (CMakeLists.txt), the entry for AI sessions (CLAUDE.md), the plan's generated view (PLAN.md), GitHub's front page (README.md).
folders..claude: Claude Code's settings for this repo: the session-start status and the locks (tools/lib/guard.mjs).
folders..github/workflows: The four workflows: deploy.yml (the game, the room), hub.yml (the site and the tools' pages), plan.yml (the plan to Dev), classic.yml (the old public bar).
folders.assets: Files the game loads while it runs (copied to the site's assets/).
folders.assets/midi: The piano's songs as MIDI files, with their credits.
folders.assets/models: 3D models (.glb) made by tools/assets/ in headless Blender, with their credits.
folders.assets/music: The jukebox's songs, with their licences and credits.
folders.assets/piano: The piano's recorded notes (Salamander Grand Piano, CC BY 3.0, J100; tools/piano_samples.sh), with their credit.
folders.assets/world: The built-in world: its schema, catalog, materials, songs list, and the kinds and places files.
folders.assets/world/kinds: What each kind of thing is (model, shapes, seats, tap areas, loops, states), one file per place.
folders.assets/world/places: Every thing in a place, where it sits and its parts, one file per place (bar, home).
folders.bar: Bar3D itself, in C++: the frame's phases, the world, the player, the bar's games and jobs, the HUD, the Studio mode.
folders.bar/projects: The bar's projects, each with its project.json (web: copied to the site; native: built into the game).
folders.bar/projects/chess: The lounge's chessboard and its computer player (C++).
folders.bar/projects/mania: 4K Mania, the rhythm game (a web page inside the bar).
folders.bar/projects/meridian: Meridian, the user's driving game (three.js, the approved exception), opened from a racing rig.
folders.bar/projects/platformer: The arcade's platformer "Test 2" (three.js, added as is).
folders.bar/projects/racing: The racing sim: track, cars, bots, controls, view, the race (C++).
folders.bar/web: The bar's page: index.html and its JavaScript bridges (menus, audio, network, voice, accounts, the live world).
folders.bar/web/badges: The badge pictures on players' cards.
folders.cloud: The room server on Cloudflare: the Worker (router), the room (one per room name), the ledger, the protocol codec, the rules.
folders.cloud/games: Games the room runs itself (darts, glasses, jukebox, race).
folders.cloud/sim: The bar's own C++ physics built for the room (room_sim.wasm), for the glasses.
folders.dev: Dev, the control room (joshuavelasco.com/dev): its page, tabs and store API.
folders.docs: The books: Charter, Playbook, Handbook, Plan, Records, and the old notes until J6.6 sorts them.
folders.docs/archive: History: old plans, instructions and notes (DECISIONS, STUDIO, ENGINE, REFERENCE, AUTOMATION, the audits...). Never instructions.
folders.docs/charter: The Charter: what the project is, the user's rules (rules.json, word for word), the glossary.
folders.docs/handbook: The Handbook: how everything works (maps, systems, pages and controls, recipes); generated/ is written by tools/handbook.mjs.
folders.docs/handbook/generated: Handbook pages written from the files by node tools/handbook.mjs; never edited by hand.
folders.docs/handbook/manual: The manual: how light, materials, the world, avatars, recipes and the timeline work, with every dial (and the road ahead for each).
folders.docs/handbook/systems: One page per system, by chapter (engine, world, site, tools, backbone), one template.
folders.docs/handbook/ui: Every page and its controls, by exact label (checked against the live pages by tools/ui_labels_test.mjs).
folders.docs/plan: The plan's data (plan.json, written only by tools/plan.mjs) and the jobs' specs.
folders.docs/plan/jobs: One spec per job after the restructure (J<n>.md), from TEMPLATE.md.
folders.docs/playbook: The Playbook: the only instructions, one procedure per situation.
folders.docs/records: The Records: known issues, and the folders below.
folders.docs/records/drills: Cold-start drills: requests given to fresh AI sessions, the answer key, the results (J8.1).
folders.docs/records/incidents: One file per error: what happened, the root cause, the fix, the proof.
folders.docs/records/requests: The user's words, exactly as sent, one file per month.
folders.docs/records/sessions: One line per session that changed something, one file per month.
folders.homepage: The site joshuavelasco.com (PHP): the front page and its sections.
folders.homepage/portal: The staff portal (/portal/: staff are sent to Dev, everyone else gets a 404).
folders.homepage/site: The site's frame (layout.php: header, tabs, footer), its look (site.css) and pictures.
folders.hub: The hub (joshuavelasco.com/hub): hub.php (news, screenshots, the Claude key, tuning), World notes, the Dials.
folders.incoming: Source material before it becomes assets.
folders.incoming/meridian/blender: Blender scripts that made Meridian's models.
folders.looped: Looped, the engine (C++, namespace engine): GPU, math, meshes, camera, input, text, audio, physics, skeletons, jobs, the profiler, the network codec. Never includes bar/.
folders.looped/shaders: The WGSL shaders, built into the game.
folders.looped/world: The world core: things, kinds, places, states, rules, loops on the shared clock.
folders.looped/apps: Programs built on the engine alone (J86): the place viewer (looped/apps/viewer, served at /bar/looped/).
folders.looped/apps/viewer: The place viewer: any place from the world files, drawn and alive, with an orbit camera; no bar code.
folders.proto: The room protocol's test vectors (both codecs must pass them).
folders.server: PHP next to the game on IONOS: accounts, the private bar's door, phone reports, the old relay.
folders.server/rooms: Leftover data of the old relay (not uploaded).
folders.studio: The Studio (joshuavelasco.com/studio): the world editor around the bar in studio mode, and the world store's API.
folders.toolbelt: The Toolbelt (every tool and the one list of projects: tools.json) and its page.
folders.toolbelt/ui-editor: The UI Editor (themes and screens) and the UI store's API.
folders.tools: The work tools and the tests (Node and shell): the front door project.mjs, piece, ship, plan, checks, records, the stores' tools.
folders.tools/assets: Scripts that make the 3D models (headless Blender) and the compressed textures.
folders.tools/githooks: The git locks (pre-commit: secrets and the plan; commit-msg: the freeze; pre-push: main).
folders.tools/lib: Shared pieces of the tools (checks list, browser, gallery, plan data, the guard, the front door's commands).
folders.tools/migrations: One-time conversions of the world files (kept as the record of what changed).
folders.tools/native: Tests and tools that run the engine without a browser (g++ and em++): physics, cars, races, the world, light.
folders.ui: The look kit shared by the site, the tools and the bar's menus: looped.js and looped.css (the parts), screens, fonts, icons, the theme CSS.
folders.ui/fonts: The fonts (with their licences in ui/CREDITS.md).
folders.ui/system: The UI store's copy: themes, tokens, screens and parts, pulled from the UI Editor (never edited by hand).
folders.ui/system/screens: Screens as data (Dev's tabs among them), drawn by ui/looped.js.
folders.ui/system/themes: The themes (colours, shapes, motion), turned into ui/themes.css by tools/uikit.mjs css.
folders.design: The design lab (J106): look-books of bolder looks for the bar's screens, for the user to react to; nothing loads it, used only when the user says so.
folders.design/theme: The lab's one theme: seven parts (menu wheel, glass strip, phone, clean panels, note cards, arcade tablet, posters).
